name: Palace of Fine Arts
note: Maybeck 1915: octagonal domed rotunda in a lagoon, arcaded, deep sculpted attic under a low saucer dome, ringed by eight free-standing groups of four Corinthian columns carrying square sculpted boxes. The curved peristyle and the exhibition hall behind are separate OSM ways.

name: Conservatory of Flowers
note: 1878 white Victorian glasshouse, domed central pavilion over two barrel-vault-ish wings.

name: California Academy of Sciences
note: Renzo Piano 2008: flat glass box, undulating green living roof, planetarium and rainforest domes, overhanging glass canopy.

name: Japanese Tea Garden Pagoda
note: Two-tier red and green pagoda, deep tiled eaves.

name: Japanese Tea Garden South Gate
note: Red timber gate, green tiled pyramid roof.

name: Japanese Tea Garden Tea House
note: Dark timber tea house, green tiled hip roof.

name: Dutch Windmill
note: 1902 smock windmill at the park's ocean end: a pale cream-grey tower in one smooth taper (no steps), a thin dark gallery ring, a broad dark boat-profiled cap, four sails several times the tower's diameter crossed at the hub.

name: Murphy Windmill
note: 1907 smock windmill, the larger of the two GG Park mills: same construction as the Dutch Windmill (tapering pale stucco, dark gallery, dark cap) but taller, with even longer sails relative to the tower.

name: Beach Chalet
note: 1925 Willis Polk, cream stucco, two storeys, red-brown hipped tile roof.

name: Spreckels Temple of Music
note: 1900 stone bandshell on the Music Concourse, colonnaded front, curved stone back wall.

name: Presidio Officers' Club
note: White Spanish colonial, arcaded front, red tile hip roof; oldest building in San Francisco (adobe core).

name: Presidio Main Post — Former Post Hospital
note: Main Post row: long red brick block with white trim.

name: Presidio Main Post barracks A
note: Main Post row: red brick block with white trim.
